_NOTE_RATE_MID: SG deliberately carries NO RATE_MID key, unlike UAE.json. Adding one was tried on 30 Aug and reverted: _skins/Eastspring.json does not override it, so a 0.075 here would have introduced a 7.5% tier into a build contracted at a FLAT 5%. If the master ever needs [[RATE_MID]] for SG, add it to BOTH this preset and every SG skin in the same change.
_NOTE_RAMP: THE RATE RAMPS; IT DOES NOT STEP. Set 30 Aug 2026. The contribution rises continuously from 5% at the floor to the full 10% at the top rung, quantised to a QUARTER POINT so every rate is a tidy figure a client can check against their own invoice (21 distinct values across the range, e.g. 5.75%, 6.75%, 8.25%). It lands on exactly 5% / 7.5% / 10% at the three published rungs, so SEAL_RATES, CONTRIB_LADDER and the site's track marks all stay true. WHY NOT DISCRETE BANDS: the rate applies to the WHOLE price, so a 2.5-point step at a threshold cost `price x 0.025` — more than the price step earned — and a client paying MORE left NoFilter with LESS. Alex ruled that out on 30 Aug. An earlier attempt kept bands and deleted the offending prices from the dial; it worked and was abandoned because it removed a quarter of the slider and made the celebration burst fire from prices the reader had not chosen. The ramp keeps every increment AND the guarantee. It also gives the forest MORE at every in-between price than the old bands did — never less — up 8.2% in SG and 17.8% in the UAE across the range. Verified on every build by tools/ladder_gate.py.
_NOTE_RATE_THRESHOLD: Set to the floor. Under the ramp there is no 'top of the 5% band' — the rate is exactly 5% AT the floor and rises with every step above it. The token is kept because _skins/Eastspring.json overrides it to 0 to disable the ladder for her flat-5% deal.
_NOTE_TOPUP: The optional top-up dial is denominated PER KG from 30 Aug 2026, matching the live site (nofilter.sg) and matching the coffee price directly above it — the unit the contract is in. It was 0-7.5 cents per cup in 0.1 steps, which converts to 0-4.17/kg in increments of 5.6 cents a kilo: a per-kilo commitment the client could neither see nor name. The dial is still 100% pass-through and still converts to cents-per-cup internally, so the 10 / 12 / 15 milestone constants are untouched (see _Locale-Presets.md, which says explicitly not to rescale them). AE is set at ~3x SG rather than at the 3.6725 peg so the dial lands on round half-dirham steps.
